lhapdf_density_convention: LHAPDF xfxQ(pid,z,Q) is interpreted as z*D_pid^h(z,Q); the adapter returns xfxQ/z.

stage1_primary.selection_reason: The clean HERMES/COMPASS stage reaches Q above about 1.4 GeV; NNFF10 has NNLO grids with Qmin=1 GeV and 101 Monte-Carlo members for pions and kaons.
stage1_primary.uncertainty: 101-member replica ensemble; member 0 is the central/average member and members 1--100 are retained as an external FF uncertainty component.
stage1_primary.fit_role: fixed collinear baseline for the first SIDIS/TMDFF closure; not a fitted FF normalization

challengers.selection_reason: Newer NNLO FF grids, but their Qmin is too high for the low-Q HERMES/JLab stages; retain as a theory/model-form challenger where kinematics allow.
Qmin about 1.3 GeV and useful for low-energy diagnostics, but NLO is not the central N3LL/NNLO FF choice; use only as an explicitly labelled lower-order variation.

unidentified_hadrons.required: Use a dedicated charged-hadron FF or define the pion/kaon/proton/Lambda composition and its model uncertainty explicitly before fitting COMPASS h+/-.
unidentified_hadrons.paper_benchmark_sum_is: The MAPTMD22 paper's pion-plus-kaon approximation is retained as a comparison-only model variation, not the default production convention.

tmdff_boundary.collinear_ff: LHAPDF member and order are fixed by the selected family.
tmdff_boundary.tmdff_nonperturbative: A separate positive, smooth FiLM-compatible factor D_NP(hadron, pid, z, bT; Q0) multiplies the perturbatively matched FF.
tmdff_boundary.evolution_and_matching: Must be supplied by the shared N3LL implementation and validated independently; this adapter does not approximate it.
tmdff_boundary.normalization: Do not fit an unconstrained FF amplitude that can trade against the PDF. Dataset normalization nuisances and external FF uncertainties remain separate.

provisional_fit_scope: 746 identified COMPASS 2026 pi/K rows; one central NNFF10 negative row is excluded from the pilot objective and remains unapproved
